name: evaluation-aftermath
description: Evaluate completed sessions — runs every 5 minutes

handler.task: Run session aftermath evaluation. Read criteria from projects/evaluation.app/criteria/criteria.md. Evaluate recent completed sessions that have not been evaluated yet. Write results to the evaluations DB table with criteriaVersion=v1.

name: evaluation-drift-detection
description: Detect per-agent behavioral drift — runs hourly

handler.task: Run drift detection. Compare recent session scores per agent against 7-day baseline. Flag agents with >10% quality drop. Write findings to projects/evaluation.app/reports/drift/.

name: evaluation-integrity-patrol
description: System integrity patrol — runs every 6 hours

handler.task: Run integrity patrol. Check active session health, compliance snapshot, and evaluation pipeline liveness. Write findings to projects/evaluation.app/reports/patrol/.
